research_question: Does same-session whole-program replay from the target initial cache state improve Official Pass@1 over the same free continuous Agent without replay?
claim_scope: Outcome-independent development qualification for selecting whether the minimal replay treatment merits scaling. The cases are not a held-out test set and cannot support generalization, leaderboard, effect-size, or SOTA claims.

selection.source: The pre-existing identity-only EnvSolve-Pro V2 Flash 0731 Dev16 order recorded on 2026-08-14, before the target-state cache-isolation repair and its mechanism results.
selection.rationale: Continue the already recorded order after the completed first eight pairs; do not replace a case based on difficulty, trajectory, or either arm's outcome.

mechanisms: Agent-invoked whole-program replay from a fresh checkout and container
no reuse of the construction package cache
raw replay evidence plus an advisory case-local contradiction returned to the same active session
final submission restricted to a replay-passed complete program

three_layer_interpretation.observation: Identity-bound construction and target-state replay evidence describing what occurred.
three_layer_interpretation.constraint: The case-local contradiction between the current complete bootstrap program and the target initial state; raw evidence remains visible and the Agent may reinterpret it.
three_layer_interpretation.operation: The unrestricted strong Agent chooses how to revise the environment and complete program in the same session.

shared_execution_identity.source_cache_policy: An immutable exact-revision Git source cache may be reused to remove source-network acquisition noise. No candidate program, construction package cache, trajectory, replay artifact, or evaluator result may cross episodes.
shared_execution_identity.package_cache_policy: Each construction episode has a private package cache; each B replay starts with the benchmark image's default empty cache.
shared_execution_identity.parallelism: At most two episodes at once, with each pair kept sequential in its preregistered within-pair order.
shared_execution_identity.timeout_disclosure: The development configuration uses a 2400-second evaluator container timeout and is not a standard-timeout leaderboard run.

outcomes.paired_analysis: Report the 2x2 paired outcome table. Use exact McNemar only when every pair has two Boolean Official outcomes; otherwise report infrastructure censoring separately.

stopping_and_decision_rules: Run all eight arm episodes unless an external infrastructure failure makes an episode censored; never replace a case based on an observed outcome.
A provider or Official-network retry may reuse only the exact generated program and may not invoke the model again unless separately preregistered as a censored infrastructure retry.

Promote target-state replay to a larger development batch only if it does not reduce paired Official success and either creates at least one B-only Official pass or repeatedly catches a state-to-program defect that would otherwise reach Official evaluation.
A 4-pair tie with replay used only as certification is insufficient evidence of success improvement; retain A and B as baselines and return to failure analysis.
Resource reductions are secondary and cannot compensate for lower Official success.
No conclusion from this batch may be described as held-out generalization or SOTA.
